title: Crunchyroll Reveals New York Comic Con 2026 Lineup With The Apothecary Diaries, Sentenced to Be a Hero, Black Clover and More
content: Crunchyroll has announced its New York Comic Con 2026 programming lineup, featuring panels, screenings and new announcements for titles including The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 , Black Clover Season 2 , Sentenced to Be a Hero and BLACK TORCH .
author: Anime Corner

title: Attack on Titan Returns With First Look at MAPPA’s Anime Comeback
content: Attack on Titan is officially celebrating its new holiday, and with it has offered a cool first look at MAPPA’s return to the anime franchise coming in a way you wouldn’t expect.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Film Streams IMAX Trailer
content: TOHO began streaming on Tuesday a new 1.43:1 (the IMAX aspect ratio) trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki : The sequel film will open in Japan on November 3.
author: ANN

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Finally Confirmed the Other Kaiju in the Movie, Ending a 22-Year Drought for Toho
content: Ever since Godzilla Minus Zero was officially confirmed to the world, fan speculation has been rampant about what other kaiju might potentially appear in the film. title: Dandadan Creator Shares Their Wildest Crossover Yet Ahead of Season 3
content: DAN DA DAN ‘s creator has returned with a wild new crossover tribute sketch for a series, from the mind behind Kakegurui: Compulsive Gambler , that’s definitely not for everyone.
author: ComicBook

title: Street Fighter 6 Game's Videos Reveal Arjun's Release on October 13
content: The official Street Fighter YouTube channel streamed new videos on Monday for DLC character Arjun, and they reveal that the game will add Arjun on October 13 as part of the Year 4 Character Pass.
author: ANN

title: Atelier Karia Game's 2nd Trailer Reveals February 25 Release
content: Koei Tecmo began streaming on Tuesday the second trailer for Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories , a new game in its Atelier franchise , and it reveals that the game will launch on February 25 worldwide for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer Spinoff Creator Returns to Shonen Jump With New Potential Hit Series
content: The creator behind a major Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba series and other Shonen Jump favorites has now made their return to the magazine with a magical new series that has the potential to be the next major hit.
author: ComicBook

title: Hotel Inhumans Anime's 2nd Season Reveals Theme Song Artists, October 4 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Ao Tajima 's Hotel Inhumans manga revealed on Tuesday the key visual, theme song artists, and October 4 debut for the anime's second season .
author: ANN

title: Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season's 2nd Part Announces New Cast Member, October 11 Debut
content: The staff for Ace of Diamond Act II Second Season , the sequel to the 2019-2020 anime of Yūji Terajima 's Ace of Diamond Act II ( Daiya no A Act II ) manga, revealed the key visual, new cast member, and October 11 debut for its second cours (quarter of a year) on Tuesday.
author: ANN
